note: An experiment (GAME_SPEC §13.7, Stage 85; docs/CURRICULUM.md, experiment 10) on data/benches/gravimetric.json: chloride by its silver chloride, filtered, washed, dried to constant mass and weighed.
title: Experiment: chloride by weight

report.label: the chloride's concentration
report.why: [Cl-] = (the crucible with the precipitate, less the crucible) / 143.32 g/mol / 25.00 mL. The last two weighings agree: the precipitate was dry. Weighed wet it would read high by the water of its cake; unwashed, by the salts dried onto it.

steps.title: The empty crucible weighed
steps.text: Pick up the crucible and click the balance: it stands on the pan. Right-click the balance and click "+ mass".
steps.why: The crucible's own mass, to take from its mass with the silver chloride in it: it was dried and cooled as the precipitate will be.

steps.title: Off the balance
steps.text: Pick up the crucible and click a free square.

steps.title: 25.00 mL of the unknown
steps.text: Pick up the pipette, click the unknown (it draws to its mark), then click the beaker.

steps.title: Until it is empty
steps.text: Watch the pipette drain.

steps.title: The pipette away
steps.text: Pick up the pipette and click a free square.

steps.title: Silver nitrate, in excess
steps.text: Pick up the silver nitrate, right-click the beaker, type 40 and click "pour": white silver chloride comes out.
steps.why: Ag+ + Cl- -> AgCl: 40 mL of 0.1 M is 4 mmol of silver, more than the chloride (at most 3.5 mmol), so all of it comes out. The nitric acid keeps carbonate and hydroxide from bringing silver out too.

steps.title: The crucible on the suction flask
steps.text: Pick up the crucible and click the flask: it stands in the flask's neck, its frit drawn on by the pump.

steps.title: Pour it through
steps.text: Pick up the beaker, right-click the crucible, type 20 and click "pour". Click 10x on the clock.

steps.title: Until it has run through
steps.text: Watch the crucible drain into the flask.

steps.title: Again
steps.text: Pick up the beaker, right-click the crucible, type 20 and click "pour".

steps.title: Until it has run through
steps.text: Watch the crucible drain into the flask.

steps.title: Again
steps.text: Pick up the beaker, right-click the crucible, type 20 and click "pour".

steps.title: Until it has run through
steps.text: Watch the crucible drain into the flask.

steps.title: The rest of the solid
steps.text: Pick up the beaker, right-click the crucible and click "tip all of the solid" (or "pour it all" first if any liquid is left).

checks.text: no silver chloride left in the beaker

steps.title: Until it has run through
steps.text: Watch the crucible drain.

steps.title: Washed
steps.text: Pick up the wash water, right-click the crucible, type 10 and click "pour". Then again, once it has drained.
steps.why: What drained left a film of the solution in the cake and the frit: sodium nitrate and the silver nitrate's excess, which would dry onto the precipitate and weigh with it. Two washes take nearly all of it.

steps.title: Until it has run through
steps.text: Watch the crucible drain, then wash it once more.

steps.title: Washed again
steps.text: Pick up the wash water, right-click the crucible, type 10 and click "pour".

steps.title: Until it has run through
steps.text: Watch the crucible drain. Its cake stays wet: the water of its pores and its frit's.

steps.title: Into the oven
steps.text: Pick up the crucible and click the oven.

steps.title: Until it is dry
steps.text: Click 60x on the clock and watch the cake dry.
steps.why: At 110 C the water leaves the cake; weighed wet, the precipitate would read high by what it holds, half a gram.

steps.title: Out, to cool
steps.text: Pick up the crucible and click a free square. Let it cool to the room's temperature.
steps.why: A warm crucible weighs light: the air it warms rises past the pan.

steps.title: Weighed
steps.text: Pick up the crucible and click the balance. Right-click the balance and click "+ mass".

steps.title: Again, to constant mass
steps.text: Back into the oven for a few minutes, out to cool, and weigh it again: the same mass, within the balance's 0.2 mg, shows it was dry.

steps.title: Warmed again
steps.text: Watch it warm in the oven.

steps.title: Out, to cool again
steps.text: Pick up the crucible and click a free square; let it cool.

steps.title: Weighed again
steps.text: Pick up the crucible and click the balance. Right-click the balance and click "+ mass".
